title: American Specialties Gourmet Tour in Greenwich Village
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Follow us to discover this 100% American gastronomic destination.
During this visit, you will learn the history of this essential district, its architecture, and especially its institutions!
Just arrived in New York, you wonder where to taste the best donut, the most colorful cupcake or the most popular burger in town? Do not search anymore!

We take you on a discovery of typical American culinary specialties in the charming neighborhood of Greenwich Village. The atmosphere is that of an urban village: small, century-old grocery stores rub shoulders with jazz bars, restaurateurs and waiters greet their customers by name.

The sweetness of life in New York!
